exposure: Active glycemic management (telephonic home glucose monitoring and centralized standardized program)
cohort: Pregnant women with impaired fasting glucose (fasting glucose ≥95 mg/dL) without gestational diabetes mellitus, who delivered at Kaiser Permanente Northern California from 2012 to 2017
finding: Active standardized glycemic management was associated with a decreased risk of LGA for women with IFG, but not with cesarean delivery.
